# Other Medications
## Cryogenics Place a beaker in a powered cryo pod and put the patient inside. Supply cold gas from a freezer. The medicines below work on living and dead patients once the body reaches the required temperature, except Opporozidone, which treats dead patients only. See [textlink="Medical Machines" link="CMUGuideMedicalMachines"]. - [bold]Cryoxadone[/bold]: heals 10 asphyxiation and 10 blood loss per unit at normal metabolism, at 213 K or colder. - [bold]Aloxadone[/bold]: heals 10 each of heat, shock, cold and caustic damage per unit at normal metabolism, at 213 K or colder. - [bold]Traumoxadone[/bold]: heals 10 each of blunt, piercing and slash damage per unit at normal metabolism, at 213 K or colder. - [bold]Urishoxadone[/bold]: heals 10 poison and 10 radiation damage per unit at normal metabolism, at 213 K or colder. - [bold]Doxarubixadone[/bold]: heals 10 cellular damage per unit at normal metabolism, at 213 K or colder. - [bold]Necrosol[/bold]: regenerates one missing native limb per 5 units metabolized at 213 K or colder. It does not heal damage. - [bold]Opporozidone[/bold]: reverses 40 seconds of rot and 20 seconds of an active revival countdown per unit in dead patients at 150 K or colder. It cannot reverse permanent death or an expired revival countdown. - [bold]Marine Cryoxadone and Clonexadone[/bold]: older Marine cryogenic medicines. They use their own formulations and work below 170 K.
## Cryogenic Recipes All amounts are reagent units (u). Use the RMC chemical dispenser reagents and Marine medicines named below. Recipe temperatures are the minimum mixture temperature when mixing; treatment temperatures are listed above. A hotplate flatpack is available from the medical supply vendor for heating temperature-sensitive recipes. - [bold]Cryoxadone[/bold]: 1 Marine Dexalin + 1 Water + 1 RMC Oxygen makes 3 Cryoxadone. - [bold]Aloxadone[/bold]: 2 Cryoxadone + 1 Aloe + 2 Marine Leporazine makes 4 Aloxadone. - [bold]Traumoxadone[/bold]: 1 Cryoxadone + 1 Salicylic Acid + 1 RMC Lipozine makes 2 Traumoxadone. - [bold]Urishoxadone[/bold]: 3 Cryoxadone + 5 Urishiol + 2 Marine Arithrazine makes 5 Urishoxadone. - [bold]Doxarubixadone[/bold]: 1 Cryoxadone + 1 CMU Unstable Mutagen makes 2 Doxarubixadone. - [bold]Necrosol[/bold]: 3 Marine Cardiocaine + 1 RMC Mindbreaker Toxin + 2 Cryoxadone makes 2 Necrosol at 370 K or hotter. - [bold]Opporozidone[/bold]: 1 RMC Mindbreaker Toxin + 1 RMC Phoron + 1 Doxarubixadone makes 3 Opporozidone at 400 K or hotter.
## Cryogenic Precursors Aloe comes from aloe plants, Urishiol from nettles or death nettles, and CMU Phenol from mutant carrots. RMC Phoron can be taken from phoron sheets or reagent tanks. - [bold]Salicylic Acid[/bold]: 1 RMC Sodium + 1 CMU Phenol + 1 RMC Carbon + 1 RMC Oxygen makes 4 Salicylic Acid at 373.15 K or hotter. - [bold]Marine Dexalin[/bold]: 2 RMC Oxygen + 5.1 RMC Phoron makes 1 Marine Dexalin and returns 5 RMC Phoron. - [bold]Marine Leporazine[/bold]: 1 RMC Silicon + 1 RMC Copper with 5 RMC Phoron as a catalyst makes 2 Marine Leporazine. - [bold]Marine Dylovene[/bold]: 1 RMC Silicon + 1 RMC Potassium + 1 RMC Nitrogen makes 3 Marine Dylovene. - [bold]Marine Arithrazine[/bold]: 1 Marine Dylovene + 1 RMC Phosphorus makes 2 Marine Arithrazine. - [bold]Table Salt[/bold]: 1 RMC Chlorine + 1 RMC Sodium makes 2 Table Salt. - [bold]RMC Lipozine[/bold]: 1 Table Salt + 1 RMC Ethanol + 1 RMC Radium makes 3 RMC Lipozine. - [bold]CMU Unstable Mutagen[/bold]: 1 RMC Chlorine + 1 RMC Radium + 1 RMC Phosphorus makes 3 CMU Unstable Mutagen. - [bold]RMC Mindbreaker Toxin[/bold]: 1 RMC Silicon + 1 RMC Hydrogen + 1 Marine Dylovene makes 3 RMC Mindbreaker Toxin. - [bold]Marine Cardiocaine[/bold]: 1 Marine Epinephrine + 1 Marine Bicaridine + 1 RMC Iron makes 3 Marine Cardiocaine.
## Body Temperature - [bold]Leporazine[/bold]: brings body temperature back to normal, treating both hypothermia and heatstroke. It also stops cryogenics working, so don't give it to someone going into a cryo pod. Overdosing causes extreme drowsiness.
## Everything Else - [bold]Ethylredoxrazine[/bold]: neutralizes alcohol in the blood, sobering the patient up over time. It doesn't stop the drunkenness they already have. Toxic in high doses. - [bold]Methylphenidate[/bold]: a stimulant that sharpens focus. - [bold]Lipozine[/bold]: burns off fat and makes the patient hungry. Mainly used against obesity.
